data.description:
## Context
While validating documentation-only leaf 717a-ebd1-42f0-4dec at exact commit d12389b8d840dee4c10ddd48e7e1801aad7373ee, the focused interface suite timed out in test_benchmark_commit_count_is_ceil_per_pass. The stack was blocked in subprocess.run for git -C <fresh repo> remote get-url origin, called by write_blocking_divergence during import_tickets. This ran concurrently with other bounded local validation. Closed bug bd66-28a4-fd31-4c9f explicitly says a recurrence on a fresh store needs a separate investigation; its mature-store foreground-maintenance fix does not explain this fresh-store occurrence.

## Plan
- Reproduce under controlled idle and concurrent-load conditions in an isolated worktree.
- Capture the exact git child argv, duration, process state, and host load at the stall.
- Distinguish scheduler or I/O starvation, inherited git configuration or hooks, credential-helper behavior, and a fixture or store-path defect with one-variable experiments.
- Fix the proven failure class and add a deterministic regression oracle without weakening time bounds.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The timeout mechanism is reproduced or falsified with recorded evidence.
- [ ] Competing hypotheses receive discriminating experiments and verdicts.
- [ ] Any fix targets the proven class and has RED-before-GREEN regression coverage.
- [ ] The affected focused interface suite passes reliably under its supported concurrency envelope.
- [ ] Findings and residual risks are recorded on this ticket.
data.title: Diagnose fresh temporary-store git subprocess timeout under concurrent validation
